reason: I already pay for Jobber and for Thumbtack leads, and I'm not stacking another $99 on something nobody outside the owner's own company has paid for yet. Maybe I'd poke at the free trial, but I wouldn't commit money.
objection: $99 a month only pays off if it actually brings in booked jobs, not if it just saves me some time. And it has zero paying customers, so I'd be the guinea pig while my leads go cold.
would_change_my_mind: Proof it answers a Thumbtack lead in a couple of minutes and books real jobs, with numbers from a few paying shops like mine. It also has to work with Jobber so I don't have to switch, and ideally I pay only per booked job or get a money-back guarantee.
